title: Toronto's First Post Office

services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: Need a space for your business meeting, presentation, game night, book club, micro-wedding or get-together?Toronto's First Post Office offers space rentals at reasonable rates! Our main rental space is our Reading Room (photographed here) including access to our kitchen and washroom. Rentals can be booked during or after open hours. Please note that booking during open hours will not grant you exclusive access to the space as we are open to the public. For exclusive use, please book after visiting hours. Review our hours of operation here.Tear down and setup must be included and accounted for in the total hours rented with a minimum rental time of 2 hours. Additional licensing fees may
